goal: Re-anchor the reputation KPIs (review volume MoM, 8-week sentiment trend, avg star) on the Review-time anchor LEAST(review_date, detected_at) so a consented Review import lands in its true months/weeks instead of a one-time spike, keep the workflow KPIs (response rate) on detected_at, and exclude responses with approved_at < detected_at from avg time-to-respond.
non_goals: Re-anchoring MonthlyImpactWorker digest counts (locked at grilling 2026-08-10: the digest is an activity summary; detected_at semantics preserved, including the unanswered-imported nudge)
Any import discriminator marker or migration (rejected at grilling: no schema change; provenance-by-column deferred until a second consumer exists)
KPI card copy / microcopy changes (locked: zero prod customers, new semantics are the intuitive reading; SURFACE stays backend)
Any change to the Review import lanes, reconcileExternallyAnsweredReview, or the Reviews list / ProvenanceBadge
TTR clamping (rejected at grilling: exclusion chosen; clamped zeros would read as faster-than-real response times)
user_visible_behavior: Review volume MoM counts reviews by their review-time month: a 100-review import redistributes into true months instead of +100 in the import month
8-week sentiment trend buckets by review-time week: an import instantly yields a real historical trend, not one spike-week bucket
Avg star windows on review-time: imported reviews older than the window no longer pollute the recent average
Avg time-to-respond never includes a pre-existing Google reply (approved_at < detected_at rows excluded), so it can never go negative
Response rate is UNCHANGED: imported unanswered reviews still drag the rate within the detected_at window (the digest-nudge reasoning from the #675 intake)
invariants: Tenant-scope predicates (r.business_id = / b.account_id = + b.archived_at IS NULL) and FROM/JOIN stay written out literally in every query template — the anchor is a lazy fragment like detectedAtWindowFilter, never a fragment that hides FROM/JOIN (scripts/ci/tenant-scope-audit.ts reads raw template text)
The Review-time anchor never exceeds detected_at: LEAST(review_date, detected_at); Postgres LEAST ignores NULLs so NULL review_date falls back to detected_at
Location-scope and account-scope queries (getLocationKpiSummary / getAccountKpiSummary) receive identical anchor treatment
No schema change; no new index (volume/trend queries scan per-business, idx_reviews_business_review_date exists from migration 031)
KPI cache behavior unchanged (45s fail-open TTL; no invalidation added)
edge_cases: review_date IS NULL → anchor falls back to detected_at (LEAST NULL-skip)
review_date in the future (provider clock skew) → clamps to detected_at; without the clamp a future-dated review silently vanishes from the trend's generate_series LEFT JOIN

Imported reply whose original Google updateTime falls INSIDE the TTR window but before detected_at: contributes a bounded negative sample today — must be excluded (the −2.9yr staging rows are already outside the approved_at window filter; the in-window case is the live bug)
Imported review older than the trend/volume window drops out entirely — correct under review-time semantics
Review detected organically (review_date ≈ detected_at) may shift one week/month bucket at boundaries — accepted, more truthful
existing_patterns_to_follow: src/lib/kpi/service.ts:124 detectedAtWindowFilter — the lazy fragment factory shape the new anchor fragment must follow
src/lib/kpi/service.ts:149 ttrHandledWindowFilter — where the approved_at >= detected_at exclusion composes in
Live-DB suite conventions: *.integration.test.ts naming, assertSchemaReady, no run-time DDL (lab-notes #573)
tests_to_add: volume MoM buckets an imported review into its review_date month, not the import month
sentiment trend buckets an imported review into its review_date week, not the import week
avg star window excludes a review whose review_date is outside the window even though detected_at is inside
review-time anchor falls back to detected_at when review_date is NULL
review-time anchor clamps a future review_date to detected_at
response rate still windows on detected_at so imported unanswered reviews drag the rate
time-to-respond excludes a response whose approved_at predates its review's detected_at
time-to-respond keeps a response whose approved_at follows its review's detected_at
rollback_plan: Pure read-path change: revert the PR. No data written, no migration; the 45s KPI cache self-expires.
observability: No new signal added — KPIs are read-only aggregates; wrongness manifests as wrong dashboard numbers, proven by the live-DB integration suite

Post-merge staging check: re-run the #688 evidence query against the #677 imported location — TTR must draw zero samples from approved_at < detected_at rows, and volume MoM must redistribute the 66 imported reviews across their review_date months
